label: PF Backlog 586
title: Backlog API: POST /items 500s under PF_ID_ALLOC=strict when the shared id authority is unreachable
body: Repro: with PF_ID_ALLOC=strict, POST /api/v1/backlog/items returns HTTP 500 (empty body) because core.id_allocator._mint raises RuntimeError('shared git authority unavailable - refusing to self-reserve') and _next_id propagates it. This blocks all API create paths. Expected: fail with a clear, actionable status (e.g. 503 'id authority unavailable') and/or make the authority reachable in the single-API deployment; document PF_ID_ALLOC=off for local dev. Found while raising BI-PF-1386.
